Messages.Author: Niklas Jansson och Åsa Johansson
Messages.Body:
Hello !

I would be very glad if someone could answer these maybe simple questions.

1. On the DS card Thoughts Betrayed it says in the superior version of text
that opposing minion can´t use any card during this combat. Does that mean
weapons and mastercards already played on the minion ?

2. On the card Bum´s Rush it says that you get an optional manuever in this
combat. If the action gets blocked do you still get the manuever in that
combat insted ?

Thanks ...

niklas....@mbox301.swipnet.se

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
"Niklas Jansson och Åsa Johansson" <niklas....@mbox301.swipnet.se> writes:
>Hello !

>I would be very glad if someone could answer these maybe simple questions.

>1. On the DS card Thoughts Betrayed it says in the superior version of text
>that opposing minion can´t use any card during this combat. Does that mean
>weapons and mastercards already played on the minion ?

No. It has been errataed to only prevent the opposing minion from *playing*
cards. Cards already in play may be used as normal.

>2. On the card Bum´s Rush it says that you get an optional manuever in this
>combat. If the action gets blocked do you still get the manuever in that
>combat insted ?

No. Blocked actions get no benefit with respect to what would've happened
if the action had remained unblocked.

Action Modifiers (Uncontrollable Rage, etc.) would remain in effect, of course.

Messages.Author: Michael Kelly
Messages.Body:
Niklas Jansson och Åsa Johansson wrote:
>
> Hello !
>
> I would be very glad if someone could answer these maybe simple questions.
>
> 1. On the DS card Thoughts Betrayed it says in the superior version of text
> that opposing minion can´t use any card during this combat. Does that mean
> weapons and mastercards already played on the minion ?
>

> 2. On the card Bum´s Rush it says that you get an optional manuever in this
> combat. If the action gets blocked do you still get the manuever in that
> combat insted ?
>

> Thanks ...
>
> niklas....@mbox301.swipnet.se

1. Cards in play may be used. Master cards may be played. The only restriction
is that the MINION may not PLAY any cards.

2. Since the card was played prior to the TB, it remains in effect. On the
other hand the minion was blocked. Because of the block, not because of the
TB, the maneuver is lost.

Hi James,

The card text is that the opposing MINION may not use any cards, and I
expect the errata was that it was only the minion who is not able to play
cards from the hand. I haven't actually kept up on the errata to TB, but
I think card text is a good reason to believe that masters (OOT naturally,
since you can't play TB during a master phase) will still be playable by
anyone who could normally play them.
